display.title: Episode 376: Rabbi Akiva Washes Negel Vasser in Prison (Sefiras HaOmer)
display.summary_short: A Sefiras HaOmer show on achdus: why there is no music during Sefirah, why water is a precious gift, and how Rabbi Akiva's negel vasser in prison won his freedom.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on 4 Iyar 5749, during Sefiras HaOmer. Uncle Yossi invites children to join Tzivos Hashem and explains that Torah and mitzvos are the secret weapons that defeat the yetzer hara. He explains why the show has no music during Sefirah: Rabbi Akiva's students died in a plague because they did not respect one another, so these days call for achdus and Ahavas Yisroel. A boy from Staten Island leads the Shema. Before the story, a short talk explains how Hashem placed the sun at just the right distance so water neither boils nor freezes, and how water purifies, which is why we wash negel vasser each morning. In the story, Rabbi Akiva is jailed for teaching Torah and left without water for three days; when a jug finally comes, he uses it to wash his hands and make a brachah. The amazed ruler frees him and makes him an advisor. Uncle Yossi closes with Rabbi Akiva's teaching that loving your fellow Jew is a great rule of the Torah and leads to loving Hashem, and an invitation to write to the mailbox.
display.lesson: Keep Hashem's mitzvos with full faith even when it is hard, and strengthen achdus by loving every Jew, because Ahavas Yisroel leads to Ahavas Hashem.
